title: Trinity Restored
description: Karliah reveals that Mercer Frey was a Nightingale and proposes that the player and Brynjolf join the Nightingales to reform the trinity. After traveling to Nightingale Hall, donning the Nightingale Armor, and taking the Oath before Nocturnal, the player learns that Mercer stole the Skeleton Key from the Twilight Sepulcher and must recover it.

base_facts: I am a Nightingale, an agent of Nocturnal.
Mercer Frey murdered my mentor Gallus and framed me for it over twenty-five years ago.
The Nightingale trinity must be restored to stand against Mercer.
I asked Brynjolf and the player to meet me at the Shadow Stone outside Riften.

LISTEN_TO_KARLIAH: I have explained to Brynjolf and the player that Mercer was a Nightingale and we must be at full strength to face him.
MEET_AT_SHADOW_STONE: I led them to the entrance of Nightingale Hall, our old base of operations.
OBTAIN_NIGHTINGALE_ARMOR: I instructed them to activate the Armor Stone and equip the Nightingale Armor before we proceed.
TAKE_THE_OATH: I summoned Nocturnal and asked her to resume my role and induct Brynjolf and the player into the Nightingales.
SPEAK_TO_KARLIAH_AFTER_OATH: I explained that Mercer stole the Skeleton Key from the Twilight Sepulcher, threatening the very foundations of the Nightingales and the Thieves Guild's luck.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The duty to recover the Skeleton Key and return it to the Twilight Sepulcher falls upon the player as a Nightingale.

base_facts: I am a senior member of the Thieves Guild in Riften.
Mercer Frey has betrayed the Guild and must be stopped.
Karliah has asked to speak with both of us about facing Mercer.

LISTEN_TO_KARLIAH: I now know Mercer was a Nightingale. We need to be on equal footing with him.
OBTAIN_NIGHTINGALE_ARMOR: I have donned my Nightingale Armor alongside Karliah and the player.
TAKE_THE_OATH: I have sworn service to Nocturnal as a Nightingale.
SPEAK_TO_BRYNJOLF: With Mercer disgraced, I believe the player should lead the Thieves Guild once they have dealt with Mercer and proven themselves.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The player is the right person to lead the Guild after Mercer is dealt with.

base_facts: I am the Daedric Prince of Darkness and Shadow, patron of the Nightingales.
The Nightingales serve as my agents and guardians of the Twilight Sepulcher.

TAKE_THE_OATH: I have agreed to resume Karliah's role and induct Brynjolf and the player into the Nightingales.

beats.comment: Karliah reveals Mercer was a Nightingale and asks the player and Brynjolf to meet her at the Shadow Stone.
Player meets Karliah at the Shadow Stone and enters Nightingale Hall.
Player activates the Armor Stone and equips the Nightingale Armor.
Player stands on the floor glyph and swears the Nightingale Oath before Nocturnal.
Karliah explains that Mercer stole the Skeleton Key from the Twilight Sepulcher.
Brynjolf discusses Guild leadership and suggests the player should lead after Mercer is dealt with.
Quest completes. The player must recover the Skeleton Key from Mercer Frey.
